paragraphs: By way of introduction, my name is Joshua Chappell. My intent is to apply for the Senior Marketing Manager position at Marcus & Millichap. I feel I have a lot of immediate value I can bring to your organization.

Your Corporate Marketing group needs someone who plans the work, sets scope and goals with internal stakeholders, and carries cross-functional projects to the finish. That is how I run my own company. At Lightbox Digital I delivered 98% of projects on time and 92% within budget while commanding teams of 5 to 20 people per project. At Grand Canyon Education I crystallized scope of work and synchronized departments with competing interests to meet and exceed stakeholder goals. I have run projects in Wrike, Notion, Trello, and Workamajig, so moving into Asana is a short step.

On the campaign side, at Charter One I created and led a video initiative that raised click-through rates for running ads by over 200%, and a social media content initiative that drove 20x more engagement than standard content. I have worked in residential real estate: I filmed model homes for Blandford Homes and photographed homes for realtors. I have produced creative work for seven years, so I speak the same language as your design team. My storyboards slashed back-and-forth communication by over 50%, and I hold a Master's in Marketing with a specialization in Marketing Analytics.
Thank you for taking the time out of your busy day to read my letter. I look forward to the opportunity of doing an interview with you.
